desc:
Build your own amazing city from scratch!

🏙️ Create anything — roads, houses, parks, shops, skyscrapers
🛣️ Raised highways, BRIDGES! 🌉
🚗 Watch cars and people bring your city to life
🌍 Choose from multiple maps and design your dream layout
✨ Level up to unlock new buildings and upgrades
🏡 Play with your friends!

Start building your perfect city today!
